The company has not provided for Post-Employment Benefits and other long term employee benefits under Defined Benefit Plans on accrual basis but provides the same as and when they become due for payment. This method of accounting is in deviation with Ind AS – 19 on Employee Benefits. outlook.statement: The Company remains optimistic about the long-term prospects of the textile industry and is focused on strengthening its operational capabilities and market position. The Company intends to focus on enhancing operational efficiency, optimizing the utilization of resources, improving product offerings and strengthening relationships with existing customers while exploring opportunities to expand its customer base and market reach.
Global economic growth is projected at 3.0 percent in 2026 and is expected to strengthen to 3.4 percent in 2027, indicating a gradual improvement in global economic activity.
India's real GDP is estimated to grow by 7.4 percent during FY 2025-26, reaffirming its position as one of the fastest-growing major economies globally.
